answer: A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each wheat is a season of logged millings plus a signed millhouse record under Flour merchant wheat bran milled at the mill house? A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. A farm can rehearse the reef and rehearse the prism, but it cannot rehearse the relic, because a year will not rehearse. An honest proof costs 162 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 444 of them, which totals 71928 POA.
